name: Lenny’s Motel
description: A hub outside Looty Bay, with Lenny’s bar, services and roulette nearby.
details: Use the dedicated motel map to browse the hub’s services, parking and exits. A separate loot table is not specified in the building reference.

name: Lair · Lenny’s Bar
description: Lenny’s bar and roulette table at the motel hub.
details: The building reference describes Lenny’s services and the roulette table. Check the hub map for the surrounding service points and exits.

name: The Prison
description: The prison buildings and grounds, reached after an arrest.
details: The community reference also identifies the prison as the place to surrender to the feds when changing servers. Use its dedicated layout for orientation; no individual loot-point inventory is included here.

name: Land Plot
description: A settlement plot used to build or relocate a player base.
details: The community reference describes plots as the starting point for a base, storage and production. Open a particular settlement from the world map to inspect its layout.

name: My Base
description: A player base for opening cargo, storing supplies and laundering money.
details: Base functions are described in the building reference. The community map’s saved plot labels are personal notes and do not report live in-game ownership.

name: Plot Plan · Other Player’s Base
description: The directory entry for another player’s base.
details: The reference distinguishes this from your own base and describes it as a potential raid target. It does not provide a verified room-by-room loot inventory.

name: Settlement Tax Point
description: The tax service point shown on the settlement layout.
details: The standard settlement layout contains 31 plot positions and a tax point. These describe the layout, not current plot availability. Open a numbered settlement from the world map for the relevant plan.

name: Settlement · Alternate Roads
description: An alternative road and building layout on the same settlement terrain.
details: The reference does not tie the alternate layout to specific districts. Choose the layout matching your game; this directory does not infer a district assignment.

name: Sales Center · Buyer & Cargo
description: The district headquarters with buyer and cargo service points.
details: The Sales Center reference shows the buyer, cargo services, parking and exits around the district headquarters. Consult the item’s actual sale conditions before comparing proceeds with city sales.

name: Hangar
description: The Sales Center hangar associated with district control.
details: The building reference identifies the hangar as the place where clans establish control over a district. Use the Sales Center map for the surrounding roads, rail line and airstrip.
